name: iSolar
old_description: Since 2020 we’ve helped income-qualified Minnesotans get solar at little-to-no cost through Xcel’s Solar*Rewards Income-Qualified program — wiping out electric bills for families who need it most.
about:
iSolar is based in St. Paul Park, Minnesota. Founded in 2019 by master electrician John Ihle and his nephew Ryan Ihle, the company is family-owned and veteran-owned. John Ihle has worked in the electrical trade since 1977 and in renewable energy since the 1980s, giving the team decades of experience before the firm’s formal launch.

The company provides full-service solar, battery storage, EV charging, electrical upgrades, and standby generator installation for residential, commercial, and agricultural customers. Its own licensed crew handles design, permitting, interconnection, and installation, typically completing on-site work in one to two days. iSolar also assists with programs such as Xcel Energy’s Solar*Rewards and USDA REAP grants, and offers a 30-year insurance-backed warranty through Solar Insure.

iSolar serves Minnesota homeowners — including income-qualified households — as well as farms, businesses, schools, and municipal buildings. Notable projects include a 100 kW array at Edina City Hall and numerous farm installations funded partly by REAP grants. The firm has been a selected co-op installer for Solar United Neighbors from 2022 to 2024.

The founders started iSolar to deliver solar “the right way” for their neighbors, emphasizing a local, no-subcontractor approach, manufacturer-certified installations, and transparent pricing. Veteran ownership, BBB A+ accreditation, and NABCEP certification reinforce its commitment to quality and accountability.
